original_question: For an arbitrary II1 factor M, determine whether the tensor product M2(C) tensor M always embeds into MU.
target_in_paper: Problem 42 in Section "Miscellaneous": for a II_1 factor M, the paper asks whether M_2(\mathbb C)\bar\otimes M embeds into the tracial ultrapower M^\mathcal U, and it adds that this is immediate when M is Connes embeddable. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
correct_elements: Your draft already has the right universal quantifier (an arbitrary/every II_1 factor M), the right source algebra (2\times2 matrices tensored with M), and the right target phenomenon (embedding into the ultrapower of the same factor). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
missing_details: Replace "MU" by M^\mathcal U; the paper uses \mathcal U as part of its standing notation. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
State that \mathcal U is a fixed nonprincipal ultrafilter on \mathbb N, as specified before the numbered sections. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
Specify that M^\mathcal U denotes the tracial ultrapower of the tracial von Neumann algebra M. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))

For a stand-alone operator-algebra question, make the tensor product explicit as the spatial/von Neumann tensor product M_2(\mathbb C)\bar\otimes M; the paper is working throughout with II_1 factors and their ultrapowers. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
If you want every hidden convention spelled out, say that "embeds" means a unital embedding of von Neumann algebras; the paper leaves this implicit. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
To match the paper's nearby context exactly, include the parenthetical remark that the question is immediate when M is Connes embeddable. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
refined_question: Fix a nonprincipal ultrafilter \mathcal U on \mathbb N, and let M^\mathcal U denote the tracial ultrapower of a II_1 factor M. For an arbitrary II_1 factor M, must the spatial tensor product M_2(\mathbb C)\bar\otimes M admit a unital embedding into M^\mathcal U? (As noted in the paper, this is immediate if M is Connes embeddable.) ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
justification: This draft is targeting Problem 42, not a broader neighboring problem. The paper's standing notation fixes a nonprincipal ultrafilter \mathcal U on \mathbb N and uses M^\mathcal U for the tracial ultrapower. In Section "Miscellaneous," Problem 42 asks precisely about embedding the 2\times2 matrix amplification of an arbitrary II_1 factor into its own ultrapower, with the added remark that the Connes-embeddable case is immediate. I did not broaden the question to an isomorphism statement or to arbitrary amplifications: nearby Problem 38 separately notes that ultrapowers are never nontrivial tensor products, so the paper's intent here is specifically about existence of an embedding of the one-step matrix amplification into M^\mathcal U. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2511.20377))
